static_traits.name: Lin Jie
static_traits.family_status: Parents Divorced; lives with a pet dog named Bart
static_traits.social_status: Good social support, many friends to talk with, but not yet discussed the Fear of the job market with friends, believing they may not understand
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological issues; never received psychotherapy; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude; clear expression, able to describe concerns specifically; good cooperativeness

basic_info.main_problem: I mainly worry and believe I will not find Work when I Graduate from university in two years. This Fear began troubling me over the past year; thinking about future career prospects makes me Anxious, and I attribute it to the current job market and economic situation. It has developed to the point where I worry about it almost daily, affecting my Learning motivation and academic performance.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling now because the Fear about future employment significantly affects my academic performance and causes stress and Increased anxiety.
growth_experiences: Last summer participated in and completed an internship: working on real projects, applying what was learned in school, accumulating coding skills and teamwork experience, and experiencing the sense of achievement of turning knowledge into results.

Last year participated in a coding competition: very nervous before the contest and convinced of failure, but ultimately performed well and received recognition, proving that one can still perform excellently under Self-doubt.

core_beliefs: I will most likely not find Work after graduation
No one will be willing to hire me

special_situations.event: Coming across news, discussions, or information about the unfavorable job market and economic situation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the overall environment is bad, I will certainly be unable to find Work
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Densely follows market information, seeks career guidance and social networks to try to gain a sense of control
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The market is so bad; I most likely will not find Work after graduation

special_situations.event: Frequently wakes at night thinking about job applications and interviews
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my preparation is not perfect enough, I will fail in the job search
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated worrying, rehearsing and agonizing over details in one's head, leading to insomnia
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will mess up in interviews; no one will want me

special_situations.event: Noticing difficulty concentrating on study and declining grades
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my grades drop, it means I am not good enough and will not be hired in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-doubt, reducing Learning investment, avoiding high-Demands tasks
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My grades are dropping; this proves I am no good and will not be hired in the future

special_situations.event: Thinking that although one has many friends, they may not understand one's Fear of the job market
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If they do not understand me, no one can provide useful support
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding expressing and discussing worries with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will not understand my worries; saying it is useless anyway

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be employed and recognized, to have a stable career prospect and a sense of control
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and Being rejected, worrying about not being needed and having one's abilities unrecognized
defense_goal: Reducing inner uncertainty and Self-doubt by attributing Anxiety to the external environment
Maintains vigilance and preventive measures in advance to avoid the blow of failure

object_relations.self_representation: An Anxious job seeker worried about not being hired
object_relations.object_representation: An external world that is hard to understand and harshly demanding (job market and employers)

object_relations.self_representation: One who worries about being misunderstood
object_relations.object_representation: Friends/others who cannot fully understand one's worries

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about or thinking of the poor current job market and uncertain future career
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treating the external environment as the decisive factor, believing one's future is controlled by the market (transference: Projecting uncertainty onto 'harsh external conditions')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Acknowledge the worries in a gentle, Empathy tone, while posing concrete, verifiable questions to distinguish external factors from personal ability and resources; use open-ended Questioning to help differentiate facts from speculation.

manifestations: Experiencing intense Anxiety and a lack of control when facing an uncertain future and career choices
Believing friends may not understand one's worries, thus not engaging in in-depth discussion
outcomes: Intensifying the Anxiety experience and self-ruminative thinking

contact_model.definition: The individual has excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, being overly cautious about contact
manifestations: Worrying about being misunderstood and thus not discussing the Fear of employment with friends in depth
Before expressing worries, excessive self-review and restraint

contact_model.definition: Attributes feelings or worries he finds hard to accept in himself to others
manifestations: Presupposing others will not understand one's worries, thereby avoiding direct communication

exception_events.target_problem: When facing career-related competitive evaluations or important tasks, the client usually Anticipates failure, with Anxiety intensified and Self-doubt
exception_events.unique_outcome: In last year's coding competition, despite being very nervous before the contest and convinced of failure, ultimately performed well and received recognition
exception_events.reason: Different approach/understanding: focusing on execution and actual practice in concrete tasks, gaining observable positive feedback, thereby briefly breaking the 'inevitable failure' narrative

exception_events.target_problem: When thinking about future job hunting and position Demands, the client usually worries about not being hired, doubts one's abilities, and reduces Learning investment
exception_events.unique_outcome: In last summer's internship, successfully participated in real projects, applied learned skills and collaborated with the team, experiencing moments of having one's abilities recognized
exception_events.reason: Different situation/support: in an environment of real projects and team support, skills were applied, gaining experience and positive feedback, enhancing Self-efficacy

positive_force: Has real success experiences (commended in a coding competition, completed an internship)
Possesses practical coding and teamwork skills
Can propose and carry out concrete plans (updating resume, learning job requirements)
Has some social support network (has many friends)
negative_force: A thinking pattern of catastrophizing and predicting the future
Black-and-white thinking and overgeneralization leading to Self-denial
Sleep and eating disturbed, further weakening learning and coping ability
Reducing help-seeking and communication for fear of being misunderstood, underutilizing support resources

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive worry and Anxiety about future employment, leading to Decreased learning motivation and focus
antecedent: Thinking about future career prospects and job-search Demands
Coming across unfavorable information about the job market and economic situation
target_behavior.core_reason: Treating the external environment as the decisive factor with catastrophic and predictive processing, while overgeneralizing academic ups and downs as one's own incompetence
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential failure and uncertainty, trying to gain a sense of control through worry and information seeking
target_behavior.consequence: Declining academic performance, Insufficient motivation, continuously worsening Anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep and diet patterns disrupted (waking frequently at night and repeatedly thinking about job hunting; occasionally skipping meals)
antecedent: Thinking of job applications and interview scenarios at night
target_behavior.core_reason: Predictive Anxiety about job-search performance and catastrophic projections triggering excessive physiological arousal
target_behavior.function: Tries to prevent failure and mistakes through vigilance and repeated thinking
target_behavior.consequence: Declining sleep quality, reduced appetite, further weakening Learning and coping resources
